title: Universal Enveloping Algebras of Hom-Lie Algebras with $α$-Derivations
summary: In this paper, we construct nonunital universal enveloping Hom-associative algebras for multiplicative Hom-Lie algebras equipped with $α$-derivations. We prove that the prescribed derivation extends to the enveloping algebra and that the resulting universal property yields a left adjoint to the commutator functor between the corresponding categories. When the twisting map is bijective, we establish a canonical isomorphism between this enveloping algebra and the twist of the nonunital universal enveloping algebra of the associated untwisted Lie algebra.
